articles.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
articles.snippet: Solana's first network-wide vote went down to the wire, with Kraken and Galaxy-linked validators switching sides before the disinflation proposal narrowly passed.

articles.title: Visa doubles down on South Korea with Upbit operator Dunamu on stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: Following a deal with Shinhan Financial, the global payments giant is widening its footprint in Asia’s major crypto hub through South Korea's largest exchange.

articles.title: Solana’s faster disinflation plan leads vote as $800K burn proposal trails
articles.snippet: All three proposals have cleared quorum, but a plan to slow new SOL creation is only narrowly passing while a separate vote to sharply increase token burns remains below the two-thirds support needed.

articles.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
articles.snippet: The approved proposal doubles Solana’s annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%, reducing future SOL issuance while leaving its long-term inflation target unchanged.

articles.title: Bitcoin bear market ‘over’ as price metric copies 2023 recovery: CryptoQuant CEO
articles.snippet: Bitcoin profitability data produced a bear-market reversal signal that was also present at the start of 2023.
